res=torch.load('/work/zres.pt')
def P(l): return f'model.language_model.layers.{l}.mlp.'
def grow(name,l,seeds,key,n,mode='z'):
    D=W(P(l)+'down_proj.weight')

    idx=sc.topk(n).indices.tolist()
    json.dump({'kind':'mlp_cluster','layer':l,'indices':idx},open(f'/work/{name}.json','w'))
    return idx[:10]
